races.display_title: PwC Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: KIMI DE MAI went close at Roscommon last time, where a mistake at the last may have cost her victory, and, back down in trip, she is taken to open her account. Impressive Galway bumper winner Brickfield Belle is feared most, with Silk Buds also respected after making the frame in bumpers. KIMI DE MAI (FR) BRICKFIELD BELLE (IRE) SILK BUDS (IRE)
